name: codex-workflow-recommender
description: Analyze a repository and current Codex environment, then recommend Codex CLI/App, AGENTS.md, skills, subagents, plugins, MCP servers, config/hooks, and OMX workflow improvements without modifying files. Use when the user asks to optimize Codex workflows or setup, recommend Codex automation, configure MCP/plugins/subagents, or says 优化 Codex 流程, Codex 工作流推荐, 给 Codex 配 MCP.

source.note: Version 1.0.0 had no manifest, declared adapter targets, or generated registry package. Empty fields preserve that absence.
